title: Very pretty
text: Very pretty. This was much fuller than a lot of wreaths at it's same price point, and the colors are vibrant.  After I got it, I realized that it matched some real flowers I had purchased earlier!  I'm very pleased with the purchase.

product_metadata.title: Decor Wreath,24" Daisy and Lavender Wreath,Beautiful Artificial Spring and Summer Wreath Front Door or Home Decoration
features: [Beautiful Flower Wreath]It is a 24 inches wreath exactly, it is colorful and full of flowers with natural grapevine base. The wreath contains jasmine, lavender, daisy and other wildflowers. The whole wreath is full and vibrant.

[Premium Quality] The wreath is handmade absolutely.We paid more attention on details and craft , we promised the flowers and leaves not easy to fall off. It is not only beautiful wreath but also high-quality!
[Versatile Decor]This beautiful wreath is suitable for indoor,wall,window and front door decoration. It will bring you much more enjoy everyday. It is also suitable for Easter and all festivals.
[Notes] The wreath may be extruded during transportation. Please shape it according to our picture instruction before hanging it. We are sure you will get a big surprise after you do that.

[Easy Clean] The wreath is easy to clean and can be used for a long time. You can blow it with a hair dryer to make the wreath as bright as new.Indoor use.If used outdoors,please make sure to hang it under cover to avoid rain and snow.If you have any questions,please feel free to contact us, we will reply in time.

[Shaping Needed]Since the package box is about 15.5 inches,the wreath is squeezed to a certain extent, making it look small. So before you hang it, you need to shape it and spread out the branches and leaves. It may take a while, but you'll get a 24 inch wreath of enough size.
description: -Handmade with jasmine, lavender, daisy and wildflowers on natural grapevine base.It looks full and vibrant,creating an enjoyable ambiance for you.
-Suitable for indoor, window and front door decoration and all festivals or wedding and party.
-This wreath is packed in a relatively small box,so it appears smaller than 24 inches,please extend it by spreading out the branches and flowers and you will get a full size wreath.
-Due to the difference of shooting angle, light and display, the wreath you received may have slight color difference with the picture.
-If you have any questions,please feel free to contact us, we will reply in time.
